name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Check lockstep package versions
        run: |
          SDK_VERSION=$(cd packages/v0-sdk && bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          AI_TOOLS_VERSION=$(cd packages/ai-tools && bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          REACT_VERSION=$(cd packages/react && bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          CREATE_APP_VERSION=$(cd packages/create-v0-sdk-app && bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          AI_TOOLS_SDK_VERSION=$(cd packages/ai-tools && bun pm pkg get dependencies.v0 | tr -d '"')
          REACT_SDK_VERSION=$(cd packages/react && bun pm pkg get dependencies.v0 | tr -d '"')
          if [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "$AI_TOOLS_VERSION" ] || [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "$REACT_VERSION" ] || [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "$CREATE_APP_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "::error::v0, @v0-sdk/ai-tools, @v0-sdk/react, and create-v0-sdk-app versions must match (${SDK_VERSION}, ${AI_TOOLS_VERSION}, ${REACT_VERSION}, ${CREATE_APP_VERSION})."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "$AI_TOOLS_SDK_VERSION" ] || [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "$REACT_SDK_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "::error::Published package dependencies on v0 must match ${SDK_VERSION} (@v0-sdk/ai-tools: ${AI_TOOLS_SDK_VERSION}, @v0-sdk/react: ${REACT_SDK_VERSION})."
            exit 1
          fi
      - run: bun run lint
      - run: bun run fmt:check
      - run: bun run generate
      - run: bun run build
      - run: bun run typecheck
      - run: bun run test

{
  "name": "create-v0-sdk-app",
  "version": "3.0.10",
  "description": "Create apps using the v0 API and SDK with one command",
  "keywords": [
    "ai",
    "next.js",
    "react",
    "v0",
    "v0-sdk"
  ],
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "author": "Vercel Team <support@vercel.com>",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "https://github.com/vercel/v0-sdk.git",
    "directory": "packages/create-v0-sdk-app"
  },
  "bin": {
    "create-v0-sdk-app": "./dist/index.js"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "templates"
  ],
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "tsx src/index.ts",
    "build": "bun run clean && tsc",
    "clean": "rm -rf dist *.tsbuildinfo",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "echo 'No linting configured for create-v0-sdk-app package'",
    "prepublishOnly": "bun run build"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "commander": "^14.0.3",
    "cross-spawn": "^7.0.6",
    "degit": "^3.6.1",
    "picocolors": "^1.0.0",
    "prompts": "^2.4.2",
    "validate-npm-package-name": "^5.0.1"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/cross-spawn": "^6.0.0",
    "@types/node": "^22.0.0",
    "@types/prompts": "^2.4.2",
    "@types/validate-npm-package-name": "^4.0.2",
    "tsx": "^4.19.2",

  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22",
    "pnpm": ">=9"
  }
}

# create-v0-sdk-app

Create [v0 API](https://v0.app/docs/api/v2) SDK apps with one command.

## Usage

```bash
pnpm create v0-sdk-app my-app
```

Or with other package managers:

```bash
# With npm
npx create-v0-sdk-app my-app

# With yarn
yarn create v0-sdk-app my-app

# With bun
bun create v0-sdk-app my-app
```

## Options

- `--example v0-clone` - Explicitly select the v0 clone template (currently the default and only template)
- `--use-pnpm` - Use pnpm as the package manager
- `--use-npm` - Use npm as the package manager
- `--use-yarn` - Use Yarn as the package manager
- `--use-bun` - Use Bun as the package manager
- `--skip-install` - Skip installing dependencies

## Template

The CLI currently creates the full-featured [`v0-clone`](../../examples/v0-clone) example by default. It is the only available template for now.

```bash
pnpm create v0-sdk-app my-app
```

## What's Included

The template comes pre-configured with:

- TypeScript support
- v0 SDK v2 usage
- Example code and documentation
- A v0 SDK agent skill at `.agents/skills/v0/SKILL.md`
- Published package dependencies for use outside this monorepo

## Development

To work on this package:

```bash
bun install
bun --filter create-v0-sdk-app build
bun --filter create-v0-sdk-app typecheck
bun --filter create-v0-sdk-app dev --help
```

name: Generate SDK

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 2 AM UTC to check for OpenAPI spec updates
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    # Allow manual triggering

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  generate:
    name: Generate SDK from production OpenAPI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    env:
      SDK_BASE_BRANCH: main
      SDK_UPDATE_BRANCH: update-sdk-from-openapi

    steps:
      - name: Checkout SDK base branch
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.SDK_BASE_BRANCH }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Fetch production OpenAPI spec
        run: |
          curl \
            --fail \
            --location \
            --retry 3 \
            --retry-all-errors \
            --show-error \
            --silent \
            https://v0.app/api/v2/openapi/json \
            | jq --indent 2 . > packages/v0-sdk/openapi.json

      - name: Validate production OpenAPI spec
        uses: oasdiff/oasdiff-action/validate@35b32248b144707e94e72a8d0a1456da9d6618c2 # v0.1.7
        with:
          spec: packages/v0-sdk/openapi.json

      - name: Generate SDK
        run: bun run generate

      - name: Format generated code
        run: bun run fmt

      - name: Create or update SDK pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@5f6978faf089d4d20b00c7766989d076bb2fc7f1 # v8.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          sign-commits: true
          base: ${{ env.SDK_BASE_BRANCH }}
          branch: ${{ env.SDK_UPDATE_BRANCH }}
          delete-branch: true
          commit-message: 'chore: update SDK from production OpenAPI'
          title: 'chore: update SDK from production OpenAPI'
          reviewers: |
            alex-grover
            rickeyswuave
          body: |
            Fetches the latest OpenAPI document from the production API and regenerates the TypeScript SDK, AI tools, and React hooks.

            Source: https://v0.app/api/v2/openapi/json

            This PR is updated in place by the daily Generate SDK workflow. The repository automatically deletes its update branch after merge.

name: release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  # Scheduled or manually triggered release lane: if main has commits since the
  # last version tag, this publishes commit-specific canaries and opens one PR
  # containing only the lockstep package versions and lockfile bump. An existing
  # PR for that version is left in place while newer main commits receive fresh
  # canaries.
  version-pr:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check commits since last version
        id: changes
        run: |
          LAST_VERSION=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*' --match 'v0-sdk@*' 2>/dev/null || true)

          if [ -z "$LAST_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "No version tag found; continuing with release PR."
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          COMMITS=$(git rev-list "${LAST_VERSION}..HEAD" --count)
          echo "last_version=${LAST_VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "commits=${COMMITS}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          if [ "$COMMITS" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "No commits since ${LAST_VERSION}; skipping release PR."
            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "${COMMITS} commits since ${LAST_VERSION}; continuing with release PR."
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true'
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true'
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json
      - if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Bump package versions
        id: bump
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true'
        env:
          BUMP: patch
        run: |
          cd packages/v0-sdk
          bun pm version "$BUMP" --no-git-tag-version
          SDK_NAME=$(bun pm pkg get name | tr -d '"')
          VERSION=$(bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          cd ../ai-tools
          AI_TOOLS_NAME=$(bun pm pkg get name | tr -d '"')
          bun pm pkg set "version=${VERSION}" "dependencies.v0=${VERSION}"
          cd ../react
          REACT_NAME=$(bun pm pkg get name | tr -d '"')
          bun pm pkg set "version=${VERSION}" "dependencies.v0=${VERSION}"
          cd ../create-v0-sdk-app
          CREATE_APP_NAME=$(bun pm pkg get name | tr -d '"')
          bun pm pkg set "version=${VERSION}"
          cd ../..
          bun install --lockfile-only
          # Bun 1.4.2 needs a second pass to refresh workspace dependency pins.
          bun install --lockfile-only
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          echo "sdk_name=${SDK_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "ai_tools_name=${AI_TOOLS_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "react_name=${REACT_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "create_app_name=${CREATE_APP_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Check published latest
        id: published
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          SDK_PUBLISHED=false
          AI_TOOLS_PUBLISHED=false
          REACT_PUBLISHED=false
          CREATE_APP_PUBLISHED=false
          if npm view "${{ steps.bump.outputs.sdk_name }}@${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            SDK_PUBLISHED=true
          fi
          if npm view "${{ steps.bump.outputs.ai_tools_name }}@${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            AI_TOOLS_PUBLISHED=true
          fi
          if npm view "${{ steps.bump.outputs.react_name }}@${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            REACT_PUBLISHED=true
          fi
          if npm view "${{ steps.bump.outputs.create_app_name }}@${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            CREATE_APP_PUBLISHED=true
          fi
          if [ "$SDK_PUBLISHED" = true ] && [ "$AI_TOOLS_PUBLISHED" = true ] && [ "$REACT_PUBLISHED" = true ] && [ "$CREATE_APP_PUBLISHED" = true ]; then
            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Resolve nightly canary version
        id: canary
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
          echo "version=${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}-canary.${SHA}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Set nightly canary versions
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          CANARY_VERSION="${{ steps.canary.outputs.version }}"
          (cd packages/v0-sdk && bun pm pkg set "version=${CANARY_VERSION}")
          (cd packages/ai-tools && bun pm pkg set "version=${CANARY_VERSION}" "dependencies.v0=${CANARY_VERSION}")
          (cd packages/react && bun pm pkg set "version=${CANARY_VERSION}" "dependencies.v0=${CANARY_VERSION}")
          (cd packages/create-v0-sdk-app && bun pm pkg set "version=${CANARY_VERSION}")
      - name: Ensure nightly canary tag
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          TAG="v${{ steps.canary.outputs.version }}"
          COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          REMOTE_COMMIT=$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${TAG}" | awk '{print $1}')

          if [ -z "$REMOTE_COMMIT" ]; then
            git tag "$TAG" "$COMMIT"
            git push origin "$TAG"
          elif [ "$REMOTE_COMMIT" != "$COMMIT" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag ${TAG} points to ${REMOTE_COMMIT}, expected ${COMMIT}."
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Publish nightly canaries
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          publish_if_needed() {
            NAME="$1"
            WORKSPACE="$2"
            VERSION="${{ steps.canary.outputs.version }}"

            if npm view "${NAME}@${VERSION}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "${NAME}@${VERSION} is already published; skipping."
            else
              npm publish --tag canary --workspace "${WORKSPACE}"
            fi
          }

          publish_if_needed "${{ steps.bump.outputs.sdk_name }}" packages/v0-sdk
          publish_if_needed "${{ steps.bump.outputs.ai_tools_name }}" packages/ai-tools
          publish_if_needed "${{ steps.bump.outputs.react_name }}" packages/react
          publish_if_needed "${{ steps.bump.outputs.create_app_name }}" packages/create-v0-sdk-app
      - name: Restore stable release candidate versions
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}"
          (cd packages/v0-sdk && bun pm pkg set "version=${VERSION}")
          (cd packages/ai-tools && bun pm pkg set "version=${VERSION}" "dependencies.v0=${VERSION}")
          (cd packages/react && bun pm pkg set "version=${VERSION}" "dependencies.v0=${VERSION}")
          (cd packages/create-v0-sdk-app && bun pm pkg set "version=${VERSION}")
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Check for existing release PR
        id: existing
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PR_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PR=$(gh pr list --state open --search "Release v${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }} in:title" --json number --jq '.[0].number // ""')
          if [ -n "$PR" ]; then
            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Open release PR
        if: steps.changes.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.skip != 'true' && steps.existing.outputs.skip != 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@5f6978faf089d4d20b00c7766989d076bb2fc7f1 # v8.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PR_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          sign-commits: true
          add-paths: |
            packages/v0-sdk/package.json
            packages/ai-tools/package.json
            packages/react/package.json
            packages/create-v0-sdk-app/package.json
            bun.lock
          base: main
          branch: release/v${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          delete-branch: true
          commit-message: Release v${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}
          title: Release v${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}
          body: Bumps ${{ steps.bump.outputs.sdk_name }}, ${{ steps.bump.outputs.ai_tools_name }}, ${{ steps.bump.outputs.react_name }}, and ${{ steps.bump.outputs.create_app_name }} to v${{ steps.bump.outputs.version }}. Merge this PR to publish them from main.

  # Stable publish lane: when a release PR is manually merged to main, the bumped
  # package versions are unpublished, so this publishes them to npm as latest and
  # creates the GitHub release. Other main pushes with already-published versions
  # skip release side effects.
  latest:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Resolve shared latest version
        id: version
        run: |
          SDK_NAME=$(cd packages/v0-sdk && bun pm pkg get name | tr -d '"')
          AI_TOOLS_NAME=$(cd packages/ai-tools && bun pm pkg get name | tr -d '"')
          REACT_NAME=$(cd packages/react && bun pm pkg get name | tr -d '"')
          CREATE_APP_NAME=$(cd packages/create-v0-sdk-app && bun pm pkg get name | tr -d '"')
          SDK_VERSION=$(cd packages/v0-sdk && bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          AI_TOOLS_VERSION=$(cd packages/ai-tools && bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          REACT_VERSION=$(cd packages/react && bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          CREATE_APP_VERSION=$(cd packages/create-v0-sdk-app && bun pm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          if [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "$AI_TOOLS_VERSION" ] || [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "$REACT_VERSION" ] || [ "$SDK_VERSION" != "$CREATE_APP_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "::error::${SDK_NAME}, ${AI_TOOLS_NAME}, ${REACT_NAME}, and ${CREATE_APP_NAME} versions must match (${SDK_VERSION}, ${AI_TOOLS_VERSION}, ${REACT_VERSION}, ${CREATE_APP_VERSION})."
            exit 1
          fi
          COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          echo "sdk_name=${SDK_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "ai_tools_name=${AI_TOOLS_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "react_name=${REACT_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "create_app_name=${CREATE_APP_NAME}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version=${SDK_VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "commit=${COMMIT}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [[ "$SDK_VERSION" == *-* ]]; then
            echo "prerelease=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "prerelease=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Check published latest
        id: published
        if: steps.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true'
        run: |
          SDK_SKIP=false
          AI_TOOLS_SKIP=false
          REACT_SKIP=false
          CREATE_APP_SKIP=false
          if npm view "${{ steps.version.outputs.sdk_name }}@${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            SDK_SKIP=true
          fi
          if npm view "${{ steps.version.outputs.ai_tools_name }}@${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            AI_TOOLS_SKIP=true
          fi
          if npm view "${{ steps.version.outputs.react_name }}@${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            REACT_SKIP=true
          fi
          if npm view "${{ steps.version.outputs.create_app_name }}@${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" version --silent > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            CREATE_APP_SKIP=true
          fi
          echo "sdk_skip=${SDK_SKIP}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "ai_tools_skip=${AI_TOOLS_SKIP}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "react_skip=${REACT_SKIP}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "create_app_skip=${CREATE_APP_SKIP}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$SDK_SKIP" = true ] && [ "$AI_TOOLS_SKIP" = true ] && [ "$REACT_SKIP" = true ] && [ "$CREATE_APP_SKIP" = true ]; then
            echo "all_skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "all_skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - name: Ensure stable release tag
        if: steps.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.all_skip != 'true'
        run: |
          TAG="v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          COMMIT="${{ steps.version.outputs.commit }}"
          REMOTE_COMMIT=$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${TAG}" | awk '{print $1}')

          if [ -z "$REMOTE_COMMIT" ]; then
            git tag "$TAG" "$COMMIT"
            git push origin "$TAG"
          elif [ "$REMOTE_COMMIT" != "$COMMIT" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag ${TAG} points to ${REMOTE_COMMIT}, expected ${COMMIT}."
            exit 1
          fi
      - if: steps.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.sdk_skip != 'true'
        run: npm publish --tag latest --workspace packages/v0-sdk
      - if: steps.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.ai_tools_skip != 'true'
        run: npm publish --tag latest --workspace packages/ai-tools
      - if: steps.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.react_skip != 'true'
        run: npm publish --tag latest --workspace packages/react
      - if: steps.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.create_app_skip != 'true'
        run: npm publish --tag latest --workspace packages/create-v0-sdk-app
      - name: Check GitHub release
        id: release
        if: steps.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.all_skip != 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if gh release view "v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
      - if: steps.version.outputs.prerelease != 'true' && steps.published.outputs.all_skip != 'true' && steps.release.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: gh release create "v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" --verify-tag --generate-notes
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

{
  "name": "v0-sdk",
  "private": true,
  "workspaces": [
    "packages/*",
    "examples/*",
    "examples/v0-clone/apps/*"
  ],
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "generate": "bun --filter '*' generate",
    "build": "bun --filter './packages/*' build",
    "typecheck": "bun --filter '*' typecheck",
    "test": "bun --filter '*' test",
    "lint": "oxlint",
    "lint:fix": "oxlint --fix",
    "fmt": "oxfmt",
    "fmt:check": "oxfmt --check"
